methodology: Items are research monitoring priorities, not incident findings. Source URLs point to authoritative publisher homepages or security advisory collections. A human researcher must verify each specific bulletin, date, CVE, and attribution before elevating it to a confirmed event.

records.title: PHP security advisories and reported exploitation
records.summary: Track PHP security releases, specific CVE advisories, reported exploitation and patch adoption. Do not infer a confirmed compromise from exploitation attempts.
records.institutional_lens: Disclosure to remediation lag, runtime attestation, accountability and verifiable patch coverage

records.title: Government cybersecurity advisories and incident coordination
records.summary: Track relevant FBI, CISA and NSA bulletins. Separate agency guidance, investigation announcements and independently established attacker attribution.
records.institutional_lens: Institutional coordination, response capacity and evidence provenance

records.title: AI agent governance and technical control standards
records.summary: Track authoritative standards and technical control publications for autonomous and agentic systems. Research hypotheses are not compliance certifications.
records.institutional_lens: Delegation boundaries, auditability, human oversight and the AI Compliance Paradox

records.title: International AI policy and institutional change
records.summary: Monitor official legal and policy developments, preserving jurisdiction, instrument status, effective date and primary-source citations.
records.institutional_lens: Nelson Model: rules, actors, interests, power, legitimacy, options and adaptation
